summary: TransparentVideo (export y) is a forwardRef React wrapper over the @hg-web/trans-video class from module 25221: it renders a <canvas> plus a hidden muted, playsInline, crossOrigin='anonymous' <video>, constructs the trans-video instance with manualStart:true on mount, exposes {video, trans, controller:{fadeOut}} through the forwarded ref (function or object ref) and disposes the instance on unmount. OperatorSection drives it by setting video.src to the operator's enter/idle clips and calling trans.activate().
